title.question: Rename 'Asta' to 'Hasta' in the catalog before distribution?
title.answer: Sean 2026-11-19: yes. Done: pulse_songs x2, radio_tracks x2, gfs_albums Album 2, two press pieces; slugs unchanged; verified live on geekfon.ai/shamanic-resin (0 Asta).

cover_upscale.question: Upscale the v2 cover to 3000 px?
cover_upscale.answer: Sean 2026-11-19: yes, try the AI upscale and see. Tried (Higgsfield bytedance 4k, 2 credits, job 0c173525): it redrew the art (Momo's expression changed, outlines thinner and scratchy, noise in the whites), failing the v4 style gate. Lanczos keeps the line art; used it. Sean can still override.

thumbnail.question: Which YouTube thumbnail: A (end-card family, all four members), B (silhouettes in the door light) or C (Aoi close-up, big title)?
thumbnail.recommendation: A. It matches the end card you approved, shows the whole band, and reads at list size. B shows the reveal moment, so only after MV day. C is the strongest click but shows one member.
thumbnail.files: design.py output: yt-A-endcard.jpg, yt-B-silhouettes.jpg, yt-C-face.jpg; Reel cover reel-cover-A.jpg

teaser_look.question: Approve the LoLA teaser look (the two stills and the storyboards) and the designer before any audio or clips are made?
teaser_look.recommendation: Approve. LoLA is drawn from her locked Support-tour references (the Roxanne video look), the cards and type are in the end-card design language (the 'your-week' design from the design team, approved on the MV end card), and the cut-aways are frozen MV frames, so the teasers match the MV. Default if Sean names a different designer: rebuild the cards in theirs, LoLA stills unchanged.
teaser_look.files: teaser-1-board.jpg, teaser-2-board.jpg; stills Higgsfield jobs e53a3d8a (teaser 1, lip highlight painted out by hand) and 3ae9f3e8 (teaser 2)
